D010-D005_h001.question:

I maxed out three credit cards buying clothes and medical gadgets I didn’t need, telling myself I was starting a clinic. I even thought security guards were sending coded messages to me through their radio static—like it was all about my “mission.”  

Then, just as suddenly, that energy crashed. For the past five months, I can’t feel anything. Not joy, not love, not even worry. I stand in front of the fridge for twenty minutes just trying to decide what to eat. I called in late to shifts, forgot meds—I’m not safe right now. But those voices, those skin-crawling sensations? That’s also when the voices started—two men arguing about me, saying she’s cheating, that she’s been seeing someone at the diner where she works. I *know* they’re not real, but I hear them clear as you. Now that the high’s fading, the voices are gone too—just like that. But I’m scared. What if it comes back?
